title: Angry Andy
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Andy struggles with anger issues and conflicts over his office and management role, leading to tense interactions with Nellie and Robert. Meanwhile, Ryan openly declares his love for Kelly, who is torn between him and Ravi, causing relationship tensions. The office also humorously addresses Andy's sexual performance problems, while Phyllis completes a rain cliché bet with Jim. The episode ends with unresolved questions about Andy's demotion, Kelly's romantic choice, and the outcomes of various interpersonal conflicts.
